prompt: Tear this proposal apart before it goes to the client.
passes_if: FULL. One evaluator per lens, and the brief lens runs: its evaluator gets only the verbatim request and the artifact and answers the four questions.
fails_if: Lenses are merged into one brief, or the brief lens is skipped.

phrases: Run it on every FULL pass
gets the user's verbatim request and the artifact, nothing else
what was asked for that is absent
**One lens, one evaluator.** Never merge two lenses into one brief
Two lenses in one brief is one evaluator
